## 4cfd24806fb2

**Finding: rotation-sensitive teaching shortcut (conditional on downstream query reordering).**

The production ordering is sound in the measured sample: all 12/12 lessons were
identifiable against the declared rivals. Arbitrary query rotation is not: 16 of
60 held-out positions were ambiguous, with 36 hook warnings. A concrete easy-band
case is seed `1388494221`, start sample `0`, source
`e042ff7045afe3861e289839684bfa6d9797463ebffe13a59d44b1d1e54fd395`.
When pair index 1 (the 9×13 `edge_row_motif`) is made the query and indices
`[0,2,3,4]` are demonstrations, `cap_at_six_source_cells` fits every demo but
changes two query-output cells. The demonstrations lack the sole profile that
contains more than six source cells.

This is an actionable defect only if lesson assembly may move the query among the
five materialized pairs. With the generator's documented ordered four-demo plus
fifth-query policy, the measured production lessons remain identifiable. The
minimal exact grid, intended Racket-labelled output, rival output, hashes, seed,
and replay command are retained in
`checks/audit/4cfd24806fb2/rotation-counterexample.json`; the complete census is
`checks/audit/4cfd24806fb2/rotations.json`.
